name: ui-vertical-pager-snap
title: Section Snap
description: Ngón tay vuốt trang dọc toàn màn hình: vuốt chưa quá nửa thì trang bật về, quá nửa thì trang bám khít sang phần kế tiếp.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio section-snap, written here): Phone viewport 96x160, three full-height panels (160 px). 0.3-0.8 s finger drags content up 50 px (power2.inOut); released under 50 % it returns to 0 in 0.85 s power3.out. 1.85-2.35 s drag to 100 px; released over 50 % it snaps to 160 (next panel) in 0.85 s power3.out; hold; reset 3.9-4.3 s. Finger dot fades in 0.1 s before each drag, out 0.1 s after; a small page map frame follows. Params: panel (160 px) · threshold (50 %) · snap (0.85 s, power3.out) · drags [[giây, px]]. Released under half a panel it springs back; over half it snaps to the next panel (0.85 s power3.out).
